execution_bounds_proposal.process_placeholder_binding: Only a separately justified Phase 3 privileged read may substitute a validated PID as one argv element. Before/after that exact read, Revalidate all four identity facts: bind PID to stat start-time ticks, cmdline /system/bin/jmcs, root UID/GID, and exe symlink /system/bin/jmcs. Ordinary observations use ps PID continuity and make no start-time claim.
execution_bounds_proposal.command_form: Every listed command is a fixed argv vector; no shell string executor, command concatenation, or caller-provided argv is permitted.
